Zaqor’s Tower

01

Unlocking Zaqor’s Tower

Wizard Master access and tower entrance

Zaqor’s Tower is weekly solo content unlocked by completing a specific task requested by your Wizard Master. After unlocking it, enter through the Wizard’s Fortress, inside Zaqor’s Chamber.

Access detailValue
Content typeSolo tower
UnlockWizard Master task
EntranceWizard’s Fortress, Zaqor’s Chamber
Final encounterZaqor
02

Weekly Structure

Floors, bosses, attempts, and reset timing

The tower has 30 floors. Every 5 floors there is a boss. The floors before each boss are selected from regular challenge types, and the final floor is always the fight against Zaqor.

RuleGuide detail
Weekly layoutEach week has a different set of floors. The order and difficulty are the same for every player that week.
Floor rewardsThe tower UI shows each floor’s reward for the week. Completing a floor grants its reward immediately.
Free attemptsPlayers may enter the tower for free 15 times per week.
Extra entriesAdditional attempts require a Zaqor’s Tower Entrance.
Attempt consumptionAn entry is only consumed when the player fails a floor.
Leaderboard resetLeaderboard resets every Saturday at daily rollover, from Friday to Saturday.
03

Tower Challenges

Regular rooms and boss floors

Challenge rooms test different parts of your build. Because the weekly layout is shared, every failed attempt can still teach the next room order.

Challenge typeWhat to expect
SurvivalSurvive the room pressure until the challenge completes.
Wave of random creaturesClear waves of enemies while managing positioning and sustain.
FirestormAvoid dangerous fire pressure while continuing the objective.
Kill the correct creatureIdentify and kill the correct target. Monsters in this challenge are walkable.
Boss floorsBoss floors can use World Boss, Quest Boss, Raid Boss, or Wizard Council encounters.
Final floorThe final floor is always Zaqor.
04

Rewards and Leaderboard

Floor rewards, completion, and weekly ranking

Rewards scale with tower progress. Floor rewards become stronger deeper into the tower, and top leaderboard players receive special rewards at the end of the week.

Reward sourceGuide detail
Floor completionCompleting a floor grants its listed reward instantly.
Boss floorsEvery 5 floors includes a boss, with difficulty depending on the floor.
Final Zaqor rewardThe final Zaqor floor has a fixed reward.
Weekly leaderboardTop players receive special weekly rewards. When multiple players complete the final floor, ranking sorts by faster completion time.
Talent Tree milestoneCompleting Zaqor’s Tower is listed as a 5 Talent Point milestone when Talent Tree milestones are active.
Glyph Token sourceFinishing the tower is listed as a one-time 100 Glyph Token reward in older Glyph Token notes.
05

Zaqor’s Wisdom

Related Wizard spell reference

Zaqor’s related Wizard spell is Zaqor’s Wisdom. The base spell makes allies within 4 tiles immune to damage for 2 seconds and cleanses them. Later spell choices can adjust the effect toward resistance, movement, healing, shielding, unstoppable, cooldown reduction, healing reduction, or offensive utility depending on selected tiers.

Spell layerExamples from the source
Base SpellAllies within 4 tiles become immune to damage for 2 seconds and are cleansed.
Tier 1 optionsFading Power, Magical Boost, Reinforcement, Natural Barrier.
Tier 2 optionsNatural Protection, Magical Thorns, Turnover.
Tier 3 optionsHourglass, Natural Disaster.
06

Player Notes

How to approach weekly clears
  1. Scout the weekly pattern. Since all players share the same floor order, early attempts help map the week.
  2. Save cooldowns for bosses. Every 5th floor is a boss, and the final floor is always Zaqor.
  3. Use failures as information. Failed floors consume an entry, but they also reveal what to prepare for next.
  4. Push clean clears for ranking. If several players finish the tower, faster completion time decides leaderboard order.
